DEP-001.reason: Normalized financial account allocation architecture in GAP-013 establishes the core AccountMovement ledger patterns needed by multi-tender split sales.
DEP-001.implementation_consequence: Implement GAP-013 account models before finalizing sale_payments account foreign keys.
DEP-001.test_consequence: Split tender tests depend on valid financial account fixtures.

DEP-002.reason: Stock adjustment financial ledger integration requires designated Inventory Valuation account structure established under financial account foundations in Wave 1.
DEP-002.implementation_consequence: GAP-013 core ledger models in Wave 1 must exist before linking adjustment movements in Wave 2.
DEP-002.test_consequence: Adjustment valuation tests require financial account seeders.

DEP-003.reason: Supplier payment reversal debits/credits financial accounts using the clean AccountMovement architecture defined in GAP-013.
DEP-003.implementation_consequence: Reversal service depends on FinancialAccountService movement rollback methods.
DEP-003.test_consequence: Supplier payment reversal tests verify account balance restore.

DEP-004.reason: Thermal and A4 receipt print formatting depends on the complete line item snapshot schema established in GAP-001.
DEP-004.implementation_consequence: Update printerService template after adding barcode/sku columns to sale_items.

DEP-005.reason: Thermal receipt print templates must format split cash/card lines based on sale_payments breakdown.
DEP-005.implementation_consequence: Format receipt tender lines from sale_payments table.
DEP-005.test_consequence: Print receipt tests check split tender breakdown.

DEP-006.reason: Idempotency key middleware and deduplication infrastructure created in GAP-019 is shared by payment reversal handlers in GAP-009.
DEP-006.implementation_consequence: Shared Idempotency trait applied to both refund settlement and payment reversal.

DEP-007.reason: Supplier return debit note workflow coordinates AP balance reductions with supplier payment reversal ledgers.
DEP-007.implementation_consequence: Supplier balance calculation methods shared between returns and payment reversals.
DEP-007.test_consequence: Supplier balance reconciliation tests both flows together.
